```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```


## Load data

```{r}
# LGA data
lga_all <- st_read("data/lga/LGA_POLYGON.shp", quiet = TRUE) |>
  select(LGA_CODE, LGA_NAME)

lga <- lga_all |>
  filter(!str_detect(LGA_NAME, "UNINC"))

crs_vic <- st_crs(lga_all)

facility_level <- read_csv("clean_data/facility_level.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

sport_level <- read_csv("clean_data/sport_level.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

population <- read_csv("clean_data/accessibility_lga.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(LGA_CODE, population_2023)
```

zones <- st_read("data/plan_zone_pprz_pcrz.gpkg") |>

```{r}
# ABS Mesh Blocks 2021 for Victoria
mb <- st_read("data/MB_2021_AUST_SHP_GDA2020/MB_2021_AUST_GDA2020.shp") |>
    filter(STE_CODE21 == "2") |>
    st_transform(crs_vic)

# Census 2021 Mesh Block counts for Victoria
mb_counts <- map_dfr(
  c("Table 2", "Table 2.1"),
  \(s) read_excel(
    "data/Mesh Block Counts, 2021.xlsx",
    sheet = s,
    skip = 6,
    col_types = "text"
  )
) |>
  filter(str_detect(MB_CODE_2021, "^\\d{11}$")) |>
  transmute(
    MB_CODE21 = MB_CODE_2021,
    dwellings = as.numeric(Dwelling),
    persons = as.numeric(Person)
  )
```


## Assign mesh blocks to LGAs

Mesh blocks data are used as residential origins and poulation weights for the distance indicators.

```{r}
mb <- mb |>
  left_join(mb_counts, by = "MB_CODE21") |>
  mutate(persons = replace_na(persons, 0))

mb_pts <- mb |>
  st_point_on_surface() |>
  st_join(lga_all, join = st_within)

unassigned <- which(is.na(mb_pts$LGA_CODE))
nearest_lga <- st_nearest_feature(mb_pts[unassigned, ], lga_all)
gap_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(mb_pts[unassigned, ], lga_all[nearest_lga, ], by_element = TRUE))
fix <- !is.na(gap_m) & gap_m <= 1000  # NA = Mesh Blocks with empty geometry

mb_pts$LGA_CODE[unassigned[fix]] <- lga_all$LGA_CODE[nearest_lga[fix]]
mb_pts$LGA_NAME[unassigned[fix]] <- lga_all$LGA_NAME[nearest_lga[fix]]

mb <- mb |>
  left_join(
    mb_pts |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      select(MB_CODE21, LGA_CODE, LGA_NAME),
    by = "MB_CODE21"
  )
```

```{r}
# Unincorporated areas are not among the 79 LGAs -> set to NA
mb <- mb |>
  mutate(
    in_uninc = str_detect(LGA_NAME, "UNINC") %in% TRUE,  # %in% TRUE handles NA
    LGA_CODE = if_else(in_uninc, NA, LGA_CODE),
    LGA_NAME = if_else(in_uninc, NA, LGA_NAME)
  ) |>
  select(-in_uninc)
```

```{r}
mb |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(is.na(LGA_CODE)) |>
  group_by(MB_CAT21) |>
  summarise(n_mb = n(), persons = sum(persons), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(persons))
```

10,062 residents (0.15%) could not be assigned to one of the 79 LGAs. Of these, 9,110 were in ABS non-spatial categories (no usual residence, offshore) and 952 lived in unincorporated areas (alpine resorts and French Island).

```{r}
# Census 2021 population by LGA, used as weights for distance indicators
mb_pop_lga <- mb |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(!is.na(LGA_CODE)) |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE) |>
  summarise(
    census_persons_2021 = sum(persons),
    # Share of residents living in Greater Melbourne (rurality covariate)
    pct_pop_greater_melb = 100 * sum(persons[GCC_CODE21 == "2GMEL"]) / sum(persons),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


## Outdoor space: Vicmap Planning zones

1. Recreational parks = PPRZ (Public Park and Recreation Zone): pulic parks, sportsgrounds, gardens, and local reserves.

2. Natural areas = PCRZ (Public Conservation and Resource Zone): national parks, state parks and conservation reserves.

```{r}
pprz <- zones |>
  filter(ZONE_CODE == "PPRZ")

pcrz <- zones |>
  filter(ZONE_CODE == "PCRZ")

# Recreational parks: PPRZ
recreational_parks <- pprz |>
  select(geometry) |>
  st_union() |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  rename(geometry = x)

# Natural areas: PCRZ
natural_areas <- pcrz |>
  select(geometry)

recreational_lga <- st_intersection(lga, recreational_parks) |>
  mutate(area_sqm = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE) |>
  summarise(
    recreational_park_area_sqm = sum(area_sqm),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

natural_lga <- st_intersection(lga, natural_areas |> st_union() |> st_make_valid() |> st_as_sf() |> rename(geometry = x)) |>
  mutate(area_sqm = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE) |>
  summarise(
    natural_area_sqm = sum(area_sqm),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Sport and recreation facilities

### Indoor and outdoor facilities

Indoor facilities: 

- Sport name contains "Indoor"
- Sport that is played indoors by nature (Gym, Table tennis...)
- Indoor surface is "Wooden Gymnasium", "Wooden Flooring", "Carpet Playing Surface", "Rubber Mat (On Wood)" or contains "Indoor"

A facility is indoor if at least one of its records is indoor. Sports that can be played either indoors or outdoors (basketball, netball, swimming, tennis) are only counted as indoor when the surface type says so; when the surface type is missing they are treated as outdoor, so the indoor count is conservative.

```{r}
indoor_sports <- c(
  "Fitness / Gymnasium Workouts", "Aerobics", "Gymnastics", "Badminton",
  "Squash / Racquetball", "Volleyball", "Table Tennis", "Martial Arts", "Boxing",
  "Tae Kwon Do", "Karate", "Judo", "Fencing", "Dancing", "Callisthenics",
  "Body Building", "Carpet Bowls", "Ten Pin Bowling", "Snooker / Billiards / Pool",
  "Ice Hockey"
)

sport_level <- sport_level |>
  mutate(
    indoor_record =
      str_detect(str_to_lower(coalesce(sports_played, "")), "\\(indoor") |
      sports_played %in% indoor_sports |
      str_detect(
        coalesce(field_surface_type, ""),
        "Wooden Gymnasium|Wooden Flooring|Indoor|Carpet Playing Surface|Rubber Mat \\(On Wood\\)"
      )
  )

indoor_ids <- sport_level |>
  filter(indoor_record) |>
  distinct(facility_id) |>
  pull(facility_id)

facility_level <- facility_level |>
  mutate(indoor = facility_id %in% indoor_ids)

facility_level |>
  summarise(
    facilities = n(),
    indoor_facilities = sum(indoor),
    indoor_with_coordinates = sum(indoor & !is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude))
  )
```

In total, about 2,000 of 9,590 records are indoor, belonging to about 1,130 of the 5,000 facilities.

```{r}
facility_lga <- facility_level |>
  filter(!is.na(LGA_CODE)) |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE) |>
  summarise(
    facility_count = n(),
    indoor_facility_count = sum(indoor),
    pct_indoor_facilities = 100 * indoor_facility_count / facility_count,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Diversity: number of distinct sports available in the LGA
diversity_lga <- sport_level |>
  filter(!is.na(LGA_CODE), !is.na(sports_played)) |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE) |>
  summarise(sport_type_count = n_distinct(str_to_lower(sports_played)), .groups = "drop")
```

## Distance to the nearest park and facility

Distances are straight-line distances (metres) from the point on surface of each populated Mesh Block (persons > 0) to the nearest destination of each type. Each Mesh Block represents its 2021 Census residents, so every LGA summary below is weighted by the number of residents.

Four destination types are used:
- `park`: Recreational parks (PPRZ)
- `facility`: Sport and recreation facilities with valid coordinates
- `indoor`: Indoor facilities with valid coordinates
- `nature`: Natural areas (PCRZ)

The main indicators are population-weighted median distances (`med_dist_*_m`): half of an LGA’s residents live closer than this distance to the nearest destination. The median is used rather than the mean because a small number of remote residents can pull the mean up strongly, especially in rural LGAs.

```{r}
# Residential origins
origins <- mb_pts |>
  filter(persons > 0, !is.na(LGA_CODE)) |>
  select(MB_CODE21, LGA_CODE, persons)

# Distance from each origin to the nearest destination
nearest_distance <- function(from, to) {
  idx <- st_nearest_feature(from, to)
  as.numeric(st_distance(from, to[idx, ], by_element = TRUE))
}

# Population-weighted median
weighted_median <- function(x, w) {
  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]
  w <- w[o]
  x[which(cumsum(w) >= sum(w) / 2)[1]]
}
```

```{r}
# Facility destinations
facility_pts <- facility_level |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(crs_vic)

indoor_pts <- facility_pts |>
  filter(indoor)
```

```{r}
origins <- origins |>
  mutate(
    dist_park_m = nearest_distance(origins, recreational_parks),
    dist_nature_m = nearest_distance(origins, natural_areas),
    dist_facility_m = nearest_distance(origins, facility_pts),
    dist_indoor_m = nearest_distance(origins, indoor_pts)
  )

# Summarise to LGAs
distance_lga <- origins |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE) |>
  summarise(
    med_dist_park_m = weighted_median(dist_park_m, persons),
    med_dist_facility_m = weighted_median(dist_facility_m, persons),
    med_dist_indoor_m = weighted_median(dist_indoor_m, persons),
    med_dist_nature_m = weighted_median(dist_nature_m, persons),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


## Combine data

```{r}
accessibility_lga <- lga |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(LGA_CODE = as.numeric(LGA_CODE)) |>
  left_join(population, by = "LGA_CODE") |>
  left_join(mb_pop_lga |> mutate(LGA_CODE = as.numeric(LGA_CODE)), by = "LGA_CODE") |>
  left_join(recreational_lga |> mutate(LGA_CODE = as.numeric(LGA_CODE)), by = "LGA_CODE") |>
  left_join(natural_lga |> mutate(LGA_CODE = as.numeric(LGA_CODE)), by = "LGA_CODE") |>
  left_join(distance_lga |> mutate(LGA_CODE = as.numeric(LGA_CODE)), by = "LGA_CODE") |>
  left_join(facility_lga |> mutate(LGA_CODE = as.numeric(LGA_CODE)), by = "LGA_CODE") |>
  left_join(diversity_lga |> mutate(LGA_CODE = as.numeric(LGA_CODE)), by = "LGA_CODE")

accessibility_lga <- accessibility_lga |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(recreational_park_area_sqm, natural_area_sqm),
      \(x) replace_na(x, 0)
    ),
    recreational_park_sqm_per_capita = recreational_park_area_sqm / population_2023,
    natural_area_sqm_per_capita = natural_area_sqm / population_2023
  ) |>
  arrange(LGA_NAME)
```
